description: Provides a preview option in the file explorer and diff viewer.
author: Test

properties.title: Draw mode
properties.description: One of: shaded, edges, wireframe. Blank means shaded. The frame also has buttons for these.

properties.title: Triangle cap
properties.description: How many facets to draw from one file. A bigger file is drawn up to this many and the view says so.

properties.title: Show the diff's old side
properties.description: In a diff, draw the base side beside the working side on a shared camera. Off draws only the working side.

properties.title: Autorotate
properties.description: Orbit on its own until you drag it. Off by default.
